value.question: What is the best Minecraft server hosting?
value.answer: The best Minecraft hosting service is the one that will provide fast performance, excellent uptime and helpful support at a reasonable price. You will need at least 2GB of memory available and 3ghz or higher processors to maintain good performance as more players join and modifications are made. It is imperative that the supplier has redundant connections and live chat representatives available to answer any questions and keep your server running at all times.

value.question: How much does Minecraft hosting cost?
value.answer: The price of hosting a Minecraft server is calculated based on the amount of RAM allocated to the customer. Some providers will restrict performance and charge more for additional slots, storage or help. Make sure to calculate the entire cost of the service to determine which is the best value and includes everything that you need to get started and continue growing.

value.question: Is hosting a Minecraft server free?
value.answer: Hosting a Minecraft server is not free as it requires expensive hardware, bandwidth and a professional staff to be able to maintain superior services and customer assistance. Some competitors offer “free” plans but charge for the things you need such as performance, removal of ads or help. There is always some cost involved in operating a reliable server with 24/7 uptime.

value.question: How do I host a Minecraft server?
value.answer: You can make your own Minecraft server by choosing a provider and determining the size that you need and selecting which version to start with. Most packages are instantly deployed and after completing checkout your server will be up and running within a few minutes. All you need to do is share the IP address with everyone you wish to play with.

value.question: How to reset your world
value.answer: To reset your world you must first log into your control panel and stop your server. You will need to change the world setting and restart your server. A new world will be generated as the server starts.

value.question: Do you offer modded Minecraft server hosting?
value.answer: We offer a wide range of mods and modpacks as part of our modded Minecraft hosting packages. Installation is simple, and we have several guides to help you through the process in our guides.

value.question: How to add a whitelist
value.answer: To add a whitelist you need to first go to your server settings in your control panel under Config Files followed by Server Settings. There you will find the whitelist option which you will need to enable than save these settings. For the change to take effect you will need to restart your server.

value.question: How to add mods
value.answer: To add mods to your server you will need to ensure that it’s version is set to Forge. After downloading the mods you would like log into your server panel, then FTP File Access, and get into the mods/ folder. Once there, simply click 'Upload' to upload them. The mods will load after restarting the server.

value.question: How to change server settings
value.answer: You can change the settings of your Minecraft server in the server control panel in your left-hand menu under config files, server settings. After locating your settings and making adjustments, you will need to save and restart the server for the changes to apply.

value.question: Why wont my plugins load?
value.answer: The most common reason that plugins will not load on your Minecraft server is that the version is set to Vanilla. For plugins to work, you need to switch your server version to either Craftbukkit, Spigot or Paper from your server control panel.

value.question: What types of server versions can I use?

value.question: Can I use plugins?

value.question: What if the server version or mod pack I want isn’t listed?

value.question: What is the difference between Minecraft Java and Bedrock?
value.answer: Minecraft currently has two different versions of the game. The original Minecraft was written in Java and is now referred to as Minecraft: Java Edition which is mostly for PC. This is the most common version found on our servers and has the best support for mods, plugins and customization. Minecraft was formerly known as Minecraft: Bedrock Edition and was built on the language C and is used for The Windows 10 edition, Xbox, mobile and more.

value.question: How do I use my free subdomain?
value.answer: During checkout, you will have the option to select your desired subdomain. If nothing is provided then a default subdomain will be generated for your server using the format username.server_id.apexmc.co. You can find your active subdomain in your Multicraft panel at panel.apexminecrafthosting.com on your server management page. Simply change the text, save the page, and your subdomain will be updated. Note: if a subdomain is rejected it is likely because it already exists in our system. Please contact support if you think this is in error.

value.question: Do I get a MySQL database?
value.answer: Yes, SQL databases are included with all of our packages. Your Multicraft control panel will have the information required for you to create and manage your databases.

value.question: Do I get a control panel with my server?
value.answer: Yes, our custom version of the Multicraft control panel is included with all game server hosting packages. This web based panel gives you complete control over your entire server with an easy to use interface. You can access the console, servers files, databases, chat and more right from here. Please contact us if you would like to try a demo of the panel before making a purchase.

value.question: What uptime do you provide?
value.answer: Our hardware has over 99.9% uptime and rarely becomes unavailable. The most common cause of a crashed Minecraft server is an issue with a plugin or mod which we can help diagnose and repair.

value.question: What is my server IP?
value.answer: To find your servers IP you can log into the members area and open the control panel. On the main page for the server, you will see your IP address in the format of IP:PORT. For example: 199.192.122.144:25712. Enter this address into your game client and you will be able to connect. Please make sure you include the IP and PORT when connecting.

value.question: Do I need to use port forwarding for my server?
value.answer: Not at all! We make it very easy to get started on your server with very little technical knowledge needed. We will send you the IP and Port combination that you will enter into the launcher which will work without any additional configuration.

value.question: How can I get support for my server?
value.answer: Our team boasts the most comprehensive support in the Minecraft server hosting industry and we look to extend that to all games. Our support representatives have in-depth knowledge of Minecraft servers, customization and the infrastructure that we use to run them. You can reach our support team via live chat, ticket or email.

value.question: Can I change my server location?
value.answer: Yes, please contact our support team here to begin the process for server migration. We will have to take your server offline temporary and the transfer time will depend on your server size. On average, a transfer between regions will be completed within a few minutes. Please note that your server IP will change so if you are using a subdomain please also request that we update this. Note: The Brazil region has an extra cost for that region and will require a paid upgrade. Please use the test location br.apexmc.co to gauge if it is a good fit for you.

value.question: How do I cancel my service?
value.answer: If you would like to cancel your server please log into your billing area and select the service you would like to cancel.

value.question: Can I upgrade my server and add more RAM?
value.answer: Yes, To upgrade your services you must log into your billing area and choose upgrade/downgrade from the left-hand menu on the service. After selecting the new package you will be able to complete the upgrade. Once payment is received your existing service will be upgraded or downgraded automatically. Your server IP and all of the files will stay the same, the only thing that will increase is the RAM and slots. Please restart your server for the changes to take effect.
